audit.why: 58.09% over 1286 games; Shen is favoured. Early levels belong to Mel's 950-range Radiant Volley; from level 3 Shen's taunt pattern takes over. Difficulty 7.5/10 stands because a landed Solar Snare still deletes a commit.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty: Mel wins level 1-2 on range, Shen owns 3 onward and every side-lane/teamfight stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was marked Mel in both layers while the prose calls 6 Shen's global spike and 'the whole reason this matchup is FAVOURED'.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse (R, 120/100/80s) is real damage but Stand United is the map-swing spike and matches the 58% win rate; the chart contradicted the page's own text.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Shen, rating 3/10 to 6/10, why rewritten around Stand United vs Golden Eclipse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel's reflect was repeatedly called 'R' / 'her R reflect'. Her R is Golden Eclipse; the reflect is Rebuttal (W). The page also claimed Shadow Dash is reflected back and taunts you.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W, 38/35/33/29/26s, 250 range) reflects projectiles and prevents Mel taking damage; Riot's text says nothing about reflecting a non-projectile dash-taunt, so that claim is unsupported. Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1000 range, hard CC) does cancel Stand United mid-channel.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal (W) named and given its 38s rank-1 cooldown; the reflected-taunt claim removed and replaced with 'it prevents her taking damage outright'; Solar Snare's cancel of Stand United stated.

audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocking autos and on-hit but not ability projectiles is already stated correctly in early; the mirror flagged the opposite error on Mel's page.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy map — track every low ally. Golden Eclipse hits at any range off Overwhelm, so recall before it lands.

edits.before: Mel's Reflect is at peak danger at level 6 and she can now execute low-health targets — respect her burst window and do not commit E into an active shield.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse (R) detonates Overwhelm stacks at any range, but Stand United outweighs it — leave lane on cooldown and never dash into an active Rebuttal (W).

edits.before: W+E+Q combo fully online — W-block her Q poke, E-taunt her into the spirit blade, and trade freely while her R reflect is on cooldown.
edits.after: W+E+Q online — Spirit's Refuge blocks autos, not Radiant Volley, so E-taunt her into the blade while Rebuttal is on its 38s cooldown.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are steady pressure in your favor — Mel has no reliable escape and no tankiness, so every time you land an E-taunt she eats a full Q trade. The critical discipline is never throwing your Shadow Dash into an active Reflect: that taunt bounces back and you take the full damage and get taunted yourself, so watch her cast animation before committing. At level 6, the lane math changes entirely — Stand United means you can give up the local CS war and hard-roam globally, tipping fights elsewhere while Mel is stuck farming a side lane. Never sit in lane at level 6 if mid or bot can be saved with your R shield; that global swing is the whole reason this matchup is FAVOURED.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are steady pressure in your favor — Mel has no reliable escape and no tankiness, so every time you land an E-taunt she eats a full Q trade. The critical discipline is never spending Shadow Dash into an active Rebuttal (W): it prevents her taking damage outright, so bait that 38s cooldown first. At level 6, the lane math changes entirely — Stand United means you can give up the local CS war and hard-roam globally, but Solar Snare (E, 11s) roots you out of the channel, so start it outside her 1000 range or after she throws it. Never sit in lane at 6 if mid or bot can be saved with your R shield; that global swing is the whole reason this matchup is FAVOURED.

edits.before: Bait out her R reflect before committing to a full combo — never throw your E into an active Reflect
edits.after: Bait Rebuttal (W) before committing — it blanks damage for its duration and is down 38s at rank 1

edits.before: Activate R to reflect your E-taunt or your Q empowered autos back at you when you commit
edits.after: Pop Rebuttal (W) to reflect projectiles and blank your Q empowered autos the moment you commit

edits.before: Mel wastes Solar Snare — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks her autos and minions, not Radiant Volley.

edits.before: Track Mel's Solar Snare: Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. When it is down — E-taunt + empowered Qs.
edits.after: Solar Snare (E, 9-11s) roots and cancels Stand United mid-channel. When it is down: E-taunt into the blade plus empowered Qs.

notes: Mel's reflect was mislabelled as her R across content and wants; her R is Golden Eclipse (120/100/80s). The claim that Rebuttal reflects Shadow Dash back and taunts Shen is not supported by Riot's text and was removed rather than restated. Level-6 row flipped to Shen in both layers to match the 58.09% win rate and the page's own prose; if Mel's audited page marks Level 6 for Mel, mirror-fix will need to reconcile.
